[!buildmode:shared] skip
[!cgo] skip '-buildmode=shared requires external linking'
[!GOOS:linux] skip

# A shared link receives the module policy. A build-mode shared link
# cannot complete: without installed package files the link has no
# explicit runtime/cgo mapping and the linker refuses the implicit one,
# so the build is expected to fail after printing the link command.
! logos build -x -buildmode=shared .
stderr '/link .* -buildmode=shared .* -logos\.cap=[^ ]+logos-cap\.json'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/shared

go 1.27
-- logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
-- shared.go --
package shared

func Answer() int { return 42 }
